author: HoyongJeong
body:
#### PR description:

Bug fix in `FastSimProducer`: the MTD propagation step (`// MTD case`) called `propagateThroughLayers` with `geometries->geometry` (the tracker geometry) instead of `geometries->mtdGeometry` by mistake. As a result the layers configured in `mtdDefinition` were never used in that step, although the MTD geometry was already built and its `mtdGeometryConsumer_` registered since #52178.

This PR changes that one argument to `geometries->mtdGeometry`. No other change.
title: Update MTD propagation to use mtdGeometry
